app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.d.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **PayPal** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.d.message:
使用已設定連線的驗證向 **PayPal** 發出自訂 HTTP / REST API 呼叫。

指定 HTTP 方法、URI 路徑（相對於連線的 API 基本 URL）、選填查詢參數、標頭以及請求內文。回應將以包含狀態碼、回應標頭和回應內文的雜湊形式傳回。

對於此應用程式中尚未公開為一級動作的端點，請使用此動作。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 請求主體。有效類型取決於 `body_type`：JSON/form/YAML 期望雜湊，XML/text 期望字串，multipart 期望檔案結構，binary 期望原始位元組。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 使用 `multipart/form-data` 上傳檔案。主體必須是 @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" 結構（filename + content + mime_type）。架構會建立 multipart 封套並設定 boundary 標頭。
使用 multipart/form-data 上傳檔案

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Pass the body to the REST client unchanged; the client decides serialization based on its configured `data` option and the value type
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 原封不動地將主體傳遞給 REST 用戶端；用戶端會根據其設定的 `data` 選項和值類型來決定序列化方式

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Pass-through; use connection serialization and let the REST client decide
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 透傳；使用連線序列化並由 REST 用戶端決定

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體作為原始位元組傳送。主體必須是二進位值。除非被 `hdr` 覆蓋，否則會設定 `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`。
將主體作為原始位元組傳送

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將表單欄位的雜湊序列化為 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`。主體必須是值為純量（字串/數字/布林值）的雜湊。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Serialize body as application/x-www-form-urlencoded form fields
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體序列化為 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 表單欄位

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Serialize the body as JSON; sets `Content-Type: application/json`. The body should be a hash, list, or scalar value.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 將主體序列化為 JSON；設定 `Content-Type: application/json`。主體應為雜湊、清單或純量值。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: If `True`, non-2xx HTTP responses return as the normal response hash (with the actual status code) instead of raising `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`. Useful for handling 4xx/5xx as data - e.g. checking whether a resource exists. Overrides the connection's `error_passthru` setting for this call only.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 若為 `True`，非 2xx HTTP 回應會作為正常的相應雜湊傳回（帶有實際狀態碼），而非引發 `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`。有助於將 4xx/5xx 作為資料處理 — 例如檢查資源是否存在。僅針對本次呼叫覆蓋連線的 `error_passthru` 設定。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Return non-2xx responses normally instead of throwing
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 正常傳回非 2xx 回應而非拋出例外

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Optional list of HTTP status codes treated as success. If set and the response status is not in this list, the action throws `REST-STATUS-ERROR`. When unset, the REST client's default behavior applies (typically: 2xx is success, non-2xx throws).
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 視為成功的 HTTP 狀態碼選擇性清單。若有設定且回應狀態不在此清單中，該動作會拋出 `REST-STATUS-ERROR`。若未設定，則套用 REST 用戶端的預設行為（通常：2xx 為成功，非 2xx 則拋出例外）。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Response status codes treated as success
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 視為成功的回應狀態碼

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Hash of custom headers added to the request. These override any default headers set by `body_type` (e.g. supplying `Content-Type` here wins over the body-type default).
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 新增至請求的自訂標頭雜湊。這些標頭會覆蓋由 `body_type` 設定的任何預設標頭（例如，在此處提供 `Content-Type` 會優先於主體類型的預設值）。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: If `True`, the response hash includes a `debug` sub-hash containing the request method/URL/headers (with sensitive values redacted), request and response sizes, and round-trip duration. Useful when investigating slow or failing calls. Off by default to keep responses lean.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 若為 `True`，回應雜湊包含 `debug` 子雜湊，其中含有請求方法/URL/標頭（敏感值已被隱藏）、請求與回應大小以及來回時間。在調查過慢或失敗的呼叫時很有用。預設為關閉以保持回應精簡。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Include request/timing/size debug info in the response
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 在回應中包含請求/計時/大小等除錯資訊

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.source: Hash of values substituted into `{name}` placeholders in the URI path. Example: with `path = /users/{id}` and `path_vars = {id: 123}` the framework sends `/users/123`. Values are URL-encoded.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 代入 URI 路徑中 `{name}` 預留位置的值 Hash。範例：使用 `path = /users/{id}` 與 `path_vars = {id: 123}`，框架會傳送 `/users/123`。值均經過 URL 編碼。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.o.message: 要附加至 URI 路徑的查詢字串參數 Hash。值均經過 URL 編碼；清單值會以 `,` 連接。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..source: Issues a refund for a previously captured payment. Can process full or partial refunds. The refunded amount will be returned to the customer's original payment method and deducted from your account balance.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..message: 為先前已請款的付款辦理退款。可處理全額或部分退款。退款金額將退回客戶原先的付款方式，並從您的帳戶餘額中扣除。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..source: The unique identifier of the captured payment that you want to refund. This can be found in the capture response or order details.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..message: 您要退款的已請款付款唯一識別碼。可以在請款回應或訂單詳細資料中找到。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..source: ID of the captured payment to refund
app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..message: 要退款的已請款付款 ID

app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..source: The amount to refund. If not specified, the full captured amount will be refunded. For partial refunds, specify the currency and amount.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..message: 要退款的金額。若未指定，將退還已請款的全額。如需部分退款，請指定幣別與金額。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..source: Amount to refund (optional for full refund)
app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..message: 要退款的金額（全額退款時選填）

app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..source: Optional invoice ID to associate with this refund for accounting and tracking purposes.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..message: 可選填的發票 ID，用於會計和追蹤目的並與此退款建立關聯。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..source: An optional note that will be sent to the customer explaining the reason for the refund.
app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..message: 將傳送給客戶以說明退款原因的選填備註。

app.UGF5UGFs.action.cmVmdW5kX3BheW1lbnQ..message: 處理已請款付款的退款

app.UGF5UGFs.desc.source: The PayPal integration provides complete access to PayPal's REST APIs for managing e-commerce transactions. Create and capture orders, process payments and refunds, manage invoices and billing, handle customer disputes, set up recurring subscriptions, and receive real-time webhook notifications. Perfect for businesses of all sizes looking to accept payments securely and efficiently.
app.UGF5UGFs.desc.message: PayPal 整合功能提供對 PayPal REST API 的完整存取權，以管理電子商務交易。建立及請款訂單、處理付款與退款、管理發票與計費、處理客戶爭議、設定定期訂閱，並接收即時 Webhook 通知。非常適合希望安全且有效率地接受付款的各類規模企業。

app.UGF5UGFs.short_desc.source: Integrate with PayPal to manage payments, orders, invoices, disputes, and subscriptions through comprehensive APIs.
app.UGF5UGFs.short_desc.message: 與 PayPal 整合，透過完整的 API 管理付款、訂單、發票、爭議和訂閱。
